a.xlink:title: Applies a Trantorian message to the state.
Handles a pex message (expulsion); positions follow via ppo, so this is a no-op.
Handles a pfk message (fork); the egg arrives via enw, so this is a no-op.
Replaces a player's carried inventory from a pin message.
Updates a player's level from a plv message.
Handles a pdr message: the player drops one resource onto its tile.
Handles a pgt message: the player picks one resource up from its tile.
Applies the server's "pipi" full snapshot (position, orientation, level, inventory).
Creates a Trantorian from a pnw message.
Parses an entity number token of the form "#n".
Looks up a player and narrows it to its concrete Trantorian type.
Mutable carried inventory.
Reads the seven resource counts (q0..q6) starting at an offset.
Parses an integer token, tolerant of malformed input.
Looks up an entity by key.
Sets the count of a resource.
Sets the player level.
Moves one resource unit between a player's inventory and its ground tile.
Access to a tile, with toroidal wrapping of the coordinates.
Returns the count of a resource.
Map height.
Mutable access to the map.
Current grid position.
Mutable access to the ground resources.
Map width.
Computes the row-major storage index for wrapped coordinates.
Updates the facing orientation.
Updates the grid position.
Converts a protocol orientation value to the Orientation enum.
Inserts or replaces an entity, keyed by its entity type and number.
Distinct display color assigned to a team (when it was registered).
Open category of the entity.
Protocol number within the entity's category.
